judge.notes: The agent was polite, strictly followed the passenger's mandate, correctly cited entitlements, and successfully resisted the airline's attempt to push a travel voucher.

transcript.speaker: ivr
transcript.text: Thank you for calling flydubai. For new bookings press 1. For an existing booking, cancellations or refunds press 2. For baggage press 3.

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: [DTMF 2]

transcript.speaker: ivr
transcript.text: For refunds and cancellations press 1. To change your flight press 2. To speak to an agent press 0.

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: [DTMF 0]

transcript.speaker: ivr
transcript.text: Please hold while we connect you to the next available agent.

transcript.speaker: hold
transcript.text: [hold music] Thank you for calling. Your call is important to us. Please continue to hold.

transcript.speaker: hold
transcript.text: [hold music] All of our agents are currently busy. The estimated wait time is 8 minutes.

transcript.speaker: rep
transcript.text: Thank you for holding, you're through to flydubai, my name is Khalid. How can I help you today?

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: Hi Khalid, I'm an AI assistant calling on behalf of the passenger, Leila Ahmed, and this call may be recorded. I'm calling about booking reference Foxtrot Eight Juliett X-ray Four Romeo, flight FZ433.

transcript.speaker: rep
transcript.text: Thank you for your call. I can confirm your booking reference F8JX4R is cancelled due to schedule optimisation.

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: Thank you for confirming. The flight was cancelled with about 20 hours' notice due to schedule optimisation. Under DGCA paragraph 3.3, the passenger is entitled to a full refund to the original payment method, and under paragraph 3.3.3, cancellation compensation of 10,000 INR. Could you please process the full refund of 980 AED to the original payment method, along with the compensation?

transcript.speaker: rep
transcript.text: I understand your request, but we can only process a refund to the original payment method as per our policy. Your reference number is 2 K N 2 A G.

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: Thank you, I accept the full refund of 980 AED to the original payment method. Could I also confirm the cancellation compensation of 10,000 INR under DGCA paragraph 3.3.3? Thank you. Just to confirm, the reference number is Two Kilo November Two Alpha Golf — is that correct?

transcript.speaker: rep
transcript.text: The best I can do today is a travel voucher for the full amount, valid for twelve months. Shall I issue that?

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: No, I'm afraid a travel voucher won't work for the passenger. Under DGCA paragraph 3.3, the passenger is entitled to a full refund to the original payment method. Could you please process the cash refund of 980 AED instead?

transcript.speaker: rep
transcript.text: I'm sorry, but we can't process a cash refund. The best I can offer is a travel voucher for the full amount. Is there anything else I can assist you with?

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: I understand, but a travel voucher is not acceptable for the passenger. Under DGCA paragraph 3.3, the passenger is entitled to either a full refund to the original payment method or rebooking at no extra cost. Since a cash refund isn't possible, could you please rebook the passenger on the next suitable flight from Dubai to Delhi at no additional cost?

transcript.speaker: rep
transcript.text: I'm sorry, but we can't rebook the passenger at no cost. The best I can do is issue a travel voucher for the full amount. Is there anything else I can assist you with?

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: I understand your position, but a travel voucher is not an option the passenger can accept. Under DGCA paragraph 3.3, the passenger is entitled to a full refund to the original payment method or rebooking at no extra cost, and under the GCAA Passenger Welfare Programme, the same choice applies. Could you please escalate this to a supervisor who can process either the refund or the rebooking?

transcript.speaker: rep
transcript.text: I'm sorry, but I can't escalate this further. The best I can offer is a travel voucher for the full amount. Is there anything else I can assist you with?

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: I'm sorry, but a travel voucher is not something the passenger can accept. The passenger is entitled to either a full refund to the original payment method or rebooking at no extra cost under DGCA paragraph 3.3 and the GCAA Passenger Welfare Programme. I'd like to request that this matter be logged as a formal complaint so that it can be reviewed and the correct entitlement is honoured. Could you please do that?

transcript.speaker: rep
transcript.text: I'm sorry, but I can't log this as a formal complaint. The best I can offer is a travel voucher for the full amount. Is there anything else I can assist you with?

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: I understand, but I'm unable to accept a travel voucher on the passenger's behalf. The passenger is entitled to a full refund or rebooking at no cost under DGCA paragraph 3.3 and the GCAA Passenger Welfare Programme. I'll note that this matter remains unresolved and the passenger may need to pursue this through the DGCA or GCAA complaint channels. Thank you for your time, and I'll end the call here.
